name: LuLu's Fun Food & Music
description: At LuLu's, every dish we prepare for you comes from recipes created by Lucy Buffett in her very own kitchen. Our entire menu—including our dressings and sauces and allergy menu—are scratch-made and never frozen. At LuLu's table, you'll enjoy authentic coastal cuisine served with a heapin' helpin' of Crazy Sista love!
